Booking policy

How booking, money and time work on Uptal Advisors. The short, honest version.

Booking and payment
Instant bookingPicking a free slot confirms the session and charges your card right away.
Prices include 15% VATThe price you see is the price you pay. The receipt shows the tax detail.
Subscriber perkActive Auto-Apply subscribers get 15% off single sessions. Bundles are already discounted.
Reschedule and cancellation
Free up to 24 hours beforeMove or cancel with a full refund any time up to 24 hours before the session.
Inside 24 hoursThe amount becomes a session credit, used automatically on your next booking.
Refunds
Advisor cancellation or no-showFull refund to your original payment method within 5 business days.
The simple ruleIf a session does not happen, you get your money back.
Written follow-up promise
A written follow-up after every sessionYour advisor sends notes and next steps within 24 hours. It is part of the price.
Privacy
Your data stays yoursYour CV and target roles are shared only with advisors you book or message.
Booking policy · March 2027. The same rules apply to every advisor on Uptal.
